subject: Next Steps: Confirmation of evaluation guardrails & exec decision forum
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Jensen <oliver.jensen@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails

Hi Oliver —

Great to meet on today’s discovery call. Quick recap and the proposal I promised:

- Primary business outcome: reduce time-to-insight for clinical ops by surfacing relevant patient notes (target: 40% faster triage).
- Success metrics (agreed): precision@10 >= 78%, end-to-end latency < 250ms for single-request flows, and false-positive rate < 8% on the flagged set.
- Data scope: de-identified clinical notes from Jan–Jun 2027 (sampling ~120k docs).
- Security asks you mentioned: SOC 2 report, data retention policy, and KMS integration.

Proposed 4-week POC/mini-trial:
1) Week 0: access & ingest sample data (owner: Marissa)
2) Week 1–2: configuration, telemetry collection, and initial eval (owner: Marissa)
3) Week 3: business metrics run and customer verification (owners: Laura + Oliver)
4) Week 4: consolidated readout and exec decision slot (owner: Sean)

Deliverables we’ll share ahead of the readout: evaluation notebook, token-level cost breakdown, and a short demo script. I attached a first-pass POC plan and a template success-criteria spreadsheet for you to annotate.

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm the three success metrics above and whether the 4-week cadence works for your team?
- Please loop in procurement (if not already) and share any contractual constraints up-front.
- If you want, we can hold an internal alignment call next week to map infra/IT owners.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, medicore-success-criteria.xlsx
From: Oliver Jensen <oliver.jensen@medicore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: 2027-10-13T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails

Thanks, Laura — excellent summary. Quick confirmations and a couple of asks: 

- Success metrics: confirmed (we’re comfortable with precision@10 >= 78% and the latency target). We’d like to add an additional business KPI: reviewer time saved as measured by average minutes per case; can you support capture of that metric in Week 3?
- 4-week timeline: OK, but our compliance team will need the SOC 2 summary and data-residency details before we start ingesting samples. Can you send SOC 2 and the retention policy?
- Procurement: looping them in here (procurement@medicore.com) — pricing & redlines will be finalized after the readout.

Minor note: our legal team prefers a short-term NDA amendment for evaluation of de-identified PHI; procurement will email a template if needed.

Appreciate the clarity — I’ll ask our ops lead (Sara) to prepare the sample exports this Friday.

Best,
Oliver
Director of Clinical Informatics | Medicore Health

Oliver — thanks for the quick confirmation and the added KPI; we can capture reviewer time saved via timestamps on the review UI and a short manual audit sample.

Marissa — can you lead the Week 0 data ingestion once Medicore delivers the sample export? Please also set up a shared folder for the eval notebook and telemetry.

Sean — assigning you the readout owner role. Can you propose two 45-minute exec slots the week of Oct 25 for the final readout + decision (we expect 20–25 minute presentation + 15–20 minute discussion)? We’ll mark the readout as the official go/no-go decision point for commercial next steps.

Procurement — appreciate the heads-up; we’ll provide a SOC2-summary and the data-retention doc by tomorrow. Laura will follow with a short NDA amendment template if Medicore’s legal requests one.

Next steps summary: 
- Marissa: data ingest & eval workspace (owner: Marissa) — due: 2027-10-15
- Laura: SOC2-summary + retention doc + NDA template (owner: Laura) — due: 2027-10-14
- Sean: propose exec slots (owner: Sean) — due: 2027-10-15

Thanks all — aiming to keep momentum this month.

Best,
Laura

Attachments referenced: SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Jensen <oliver.jensen@medicore.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@medicore.com
Date: 2027-10-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails — Exec readout scheduling

Oliver / team — thanks, all. Two proposed 45-minute windows for the exec readout (please pick whichever is easiest):

- Option A: Tuesday, Oct 26, 2027, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Option B: Wednesday, Oct 27, 2027, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Draft readout agenda (20–25 min presentation + 15–20 min decision):
1) Objective + success criteria recap (Laura)
2) Key telemetry and evaluation results (Marissa)
3) Demo: sample flows & failures (Marissa)
4) Business KPI read: reviewer time saved + precision metrics (Oliver + Laura)
5) Decision & next commercial step (Sean)

Decision rubric (go / needs more work / no-go):
- Go: all three technical thresholds met or exceeded AND procurement has indicated acceptable commercial terms (heads-down redline acceptable)
- Needs more work: technical thresholds partially met OR one threshold missed but fix is planned within 2 weeks with high confidence
- No-go: critical security/compliance blocker OR technical results substantively below thresholds with no near-term remediation path

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (updated), DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?envelopeId=abc-123-poc

Please confirm preferred slot and who from your exec team will attend (we recommend a clinical lead + procurement decision-maker). Once we lock time I’ll send a formal calendar invite and a short prep deck.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
